subject: Re: Kickoff: Reviews2Movielens as a first-class internal benchmark
body:
Dmitri,

Resourcing picture. Ingestion is cheap — this is CPU-side joining and validation, no accelerator ask. Staffing: Freya owns the benchmark spec, Yusuf and Halima on baselines, Leilani on platform work.

The big platform piece: for teams to actually adopt this benchmark we need a leaderboard, and there's nothing reusable in-house, so we're scoping and staffing a benchmark leaderboard service built from scratch. Leilani leads it at 60% from March 2 — submission API, score validation against the held-out split, and a rankings UI. I've budgeted eight engineer-weeks and want it live by April 17 so baselines land on it, not before it.

One watch item: the Amazon-to-MovieLens mapping is many-to-one and 97% accurate on a 200-sample audit — we should decide whether leaderboard scoring excludes the ambiguous ASINs (collections of several titles).

Ivo
